messages:
jana: Quick update — I pushed fixes for #482 (kv-rotator). Addressed the null-kv edge case and tightened a unit test. CI is failing on a lint rule (line length in allocator.go). Can someone advise: squash into one commit or keep the fixups? Need to land before tomorrow's canary window.

liam: Thanks — I'll take a look in ~30m. If it's just lint you can run `gofmt` + `golangci-lint run` locally. Repo prefers squashed merges but keep whatever helps debugging.

priya: I can pick up the lint now. @jana can you paste the failing output? PTAL after I push the fix.

jana: Failing output: `allocator.go:312: Line is 125 chars (gofmt)`. I can shorten a var name or wrap the expression. Trying a tiny change and will force-push.

oliver: FYI we've been seeing intermittent flakes on `TestAllocatorRotation` lately — don't let that block the canary. If tests fail locally, ping me and I can rerun CI.

ci-bot: build started for jana/kv-rotator-fix (commit f3a9c2).

liam: Quick preference: squash into a descriptive commit like `kv: handle nil entries + lint` so release notes are clean. If you want separate authorship, use `Co-authored-by:` footer. Re-request review when pushed.

jana: Pushed squash -> `git push --force origin jana/kv-rotator-fix`. PTAL @liam @priya

ci-bot: build passed. All checks green.

priya: LGTM, left one tiny nit suggestion inline (non-blocking). :+1:

liam: Approved. I'll merge into the canary slot at 10:30 PST unless anyone objects.

oliver: No objections. Please add a short changelog line for canary notes.

jana: Added a one-liner changelog in the last commit. Thanks all — merging now.
